description: Health brochures enclosed in an envelope from the New Mexico County Department of Health addressed to Miss Georgia O'Keefe. Brochures cover topics such as diphtheria, measles, whooping cough, tuberculosis and the care of babies.
imageCaption: Envelope from New Mexico County Department of Public Health to Miss Georgia O'Keefe, undated. Ghost Ranch Papers. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. © Georgia O'Keeffe Museum.
